title: Configuration options — etcd v3.7
locator: Auth flags: --auth-token supports simple or jwt; --auth-token-ttl defaults to 300 seconds for the simple token. JWT token TTL is specified in auth-token JWT options.
notes: Used to identify the documented token type options and default simple-token TTL. The exact deployed etcd v3.7.0 behavior is additionally verified by the disposable integration test; do not confuse this setting with KV lease TTL.
